name: Capital One Spark Cash Plus

welcome_offer.description: Earn a $2,000 cash bonus after spending $30,000 on purchases in the first 3 months. Plus, earn an additional $2,000 cash bonus for every $500,000 spent during the first year.
notes: 2026-09-29 official Capital One Spark Cash Plus page: $2,000 after $30,000/3 months plus $2,000 per $500K first-year spend (page headline: "Our biggest offer ever: earn $4,000 or more in cash bonuses"); no limited-time Business Travel credit or end date shown (prior $500 travel-credit promo ended ~2026-09-07).

earning_rates.notes: Unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase, every day
